Shared Service Core and four gap states are deterministic; safety/source relevance and prior attempts are not yet combined into GapPlan.
Queries, manufacturer paths and prospect creation are prompt-orchestrated.
Source and prospect records exist in several incompatible shapes without one validator or stable attempt history.
All-fields gate is deterministic but embedded in a reassessment dataset and fed by manually authored booleans.
Fail-closed pieces exist, but representations differ and neither contract covers every model/year/market/transmission/ABS/equipment dimension consistently.
Disposition vocabulary exists; each execution constructs source attempts and budgets by hand.
Candidate validation is reusable; candidate construction and promotion into evidence remain manual and two schemas coexist.
Only ml/L, psi/bar/kPa and N·m numeric conversions are covered; intervals, clearances, part numbers and action semantics are not canonicalized.
Conflicts are preserved and never auto-selected; richer normalized-match/applicability-split classification is still needed.
Coverage is generic; practical/generic yield, document budgets and per-document yield are recomputed in handcrafted batch result modules.
Stable queues exist but lack canonical typed reasons, source work items, ownership and resolution state.
Repository commits preserve history, but no stable batch/attempt/work-item state machine resumes without handcrafted reconstruction.
Human review is governed but decisions have no generic machine-readable contract.
Boundary is intentionally manual and tested; it must remain outside the factory orchestrator.

manualDecisions.rationale: Catalogue identity can seed targets, but exact year/market/transmission/ABS/equipment policies must be explicit and reviewable.
Agents/adapters may propose sources; authority and applicability cannot be inferred.
Manufacturer adapters may emit bounded query hints, never evidence or readiness decisions.
Publication identity/content hash already supports deterministic deduplication.
Once findings are recorded, ADR-012 is an all-fields gate.
Exact scope matches and UNKNOWN blocking are policy; ambiguous external facts become review items.
Authority, marginal gap relevance, access, duplication, risk and prior yield are explicit inputs.
Tools/agents may propose candidates; safety-critical candidates need independent validation.
Only registered conversions/parsers may normalize; unknown forms remain raw.
Detection is deterministic, but selecting among applicable authoritative disagreements requires judgment/new evidence.
Automation may block or queue, never waive unresolved applicability/conflicts.
Configured per batch/target and enforced deterministically.
Attempt identities, repeated blockers and configured limits can generate terminal stop reasons.
Existing governance requires a separate deliberate task and validator review.
Platform/model similarity must never create scope or values.

ResearchTarget.rule: Reference canonical catalogue identity; store only the bounded research scope and never duplicate mutable catalogue facts.

SourceProspect.rule: Manufacturer adapters may add opaque metadata under adapterData; core gate fields remain manufacturer-neutral.

ApplicabilityScope.unknownSemantics: UNKNOWN blocks applicability; null is never universal; abs false remains distinct from null
ApplicabilityScope.rule: Every dimension is evaluated independently and fail-closed before source or evidence acceptance.

GapPlan.rule: Generated from canonical evidence/history; answers what remains without prompt-authored field lists.

SourceWorkItem.rule: One deterministic unit of external work with immutable input references and append-only results.

EvidenceCandidate.rule: Original value/unit and exact provenance are immutable; extraction never directly creates verified production data.

ReviewItem.rule: Resolution is human-authored where judgment is required and never auto-promotes.

sourceDiscovery.output: ranked SourceProspect proposals with discovery provenance and UNKNOWN fields preserved
sourceDiscovery.nonGoal: No crawler or autonomous browser in MVP.

sourcePriorityPolicy.rule: Order is a default, not a winner: marginal practical relevance and readiness may make an owner manual better than a blocked service manual; Tier C/D cannot establish practical success.

readinessGate.currentAssessment: Concept is generic, implementation is duplicated/embedded in prospect-reassessment and target-specific result modules; extract one canonical validator/reducer in Factory Foundation.

stopEarlyRules: stop when target wave completion is reached
second source requires a recorded remaining-gap rationale
structural access/applicability blockers exhaust that path
budgetEngine.rationale: Prior batches used 1–3 documents per target, but evidence is insufficient for universal numeric governance; profiles configure limits and the engine enforces them.

normalization.rule: Unknown parsers preserve original values and create NORMALIZATION-UNCERTAINTY review items.

existing: same scoped slot differing normalized values becomes CONFLICT
conflictEngine.rule: Commonness, source count and numerical averaging never resolve conflicts.

exhaustion.currentState: Terms and examples exist, but no generic reducer/event history.

completion.rule: A target may be EXHAUSTED or BLOCKED below 44/44; DONE is wave-relative, never production-ready by implication.

behavior: rank marginal practical opportunity per bounded document
never use fame/popularity as a default factor
scheduler.currentGap: Existing priorityScore rewards verified slots/source count and does not consume prospect readiness, marginal field relevance or work history.

implementationWaves.name: FACTORY FOUNDATION
implementationWaves.objective: Implement versioned core contracts, validators and one canonical readiness/applicability gate.
implementationWaves.migrationImpact: none; adapters later preserve current datasets
implementationWaves.nonGoals: No orchestration, external research, data migration or live prospect execution.
implementationWaves.exitCriteria: Synthetic and current-shaped adapters validate fail-closed without changing existing evidence.

implementationWaves.name: FACTORY ORCHESTRATOR
implementationWaves.objective: Add Batch/WorkItem/Attempt/Event identities, reducer, budgets, completion and checkpoint snapshots.
implementationWaves.nonGoals: No external source calls or extraction.
implementationWaves.exitCriteria: Interrupted synthetic batches resume byte-deterministically and enforce stop rules.

implementationWaves.name: FACTORY WORK ITEMS
implementationWaves.objective: Generate target GapPlans, prospect/authentication/acquisition/extraction work items and typed review items; ingest external findings.
implementationWaves.nonGoals: No autonomous browser, crawler, OCR or LLM extractor.
implementationWaves.exitCriteria: Multiple synthetic targets produce bounded work and reports without target-specific scripts.

implementationWaves.name: FACTORY BATCH PILOT
implementationWaves.objective: Run a small non-production batch through the orchestrator using existing known prospects, including Ténéré BW3-F8197-E0 as an authentication fixture.
implementationWaves.nonGoals: No production promotion and no batch-size scaling.
implementationWaves.exitCriteria: One interrupted/resumed pilot proves gates, budgets, anti-loop, metrics and review queue.

implementationWaves.name: FACTORY SCALE-UP
implementationWaves.objective: Exercise 10 then 25 targets, add only evidence-backed adapters and optimize report/checkpoint volume before considering 100.
implementationWaves.exitCriteria: 25 targets remain deterministic, bounded, resumable and auditable with measured review load.

tenerePilot.executionTiming: FACTORY BATCH PILOT after foundation/orchestrator/work-item waves
tenerePilot.reason: Known unresolved year/market/equipment/access fields exercise the generic gate without inventing a fixture.

exactNextTasks.task: Implement the bounded Technical Research Factory Foundation: add versioned, manufacturer-neutral ResearchTarget, SourceProspect, ApplicabilityScope and GapPlan contracts with validators, then extract one canonical fail-closed readiness/applicability gate behind compatibility adapters for synthetic/current-shaped fixtures; perform no external research, live data migration, acquisition, extraction or production change.
exactNextTasks.leverage: Every later scheduler, work item, checkpoint, budget and review component depends on stable identities/scopes and one gate; implementing orchestration first would encode today's fragmented shapes.
